scores.tell: Stone table and stools have soft painted gradients with faint vein texture, and the shadows on the grass are soft and plausible. The form turn is a bit flat, with little core shadow on the pedestal. It reads closer to the illustrated swing card than to the glossy 3D cards, and the stone texture is a little busy.

The coffin has a sharp white specular streak on its top-left edge and a hard, banded light-to-dark turn on its right side face. The wood grain gradient looks like glossy plastic, and the cross has a crisp bevel highlight. The cast shadow is a hard dark oval on the grass. This is more glossy and hard-lit than the real cards.

none. The calculator has soft broad sheen, smooth form turn, gentle core shadow and rounded bevels. The keys have soft highlights and the shadow depth is moderate, which matches the real towel's smooth 3D look.
